LU-10

LUBRICATION - OIL PUMP

SST                    SST

R3053 R3054                                Z02375

11.    REMOVE NO.2 OIL PAN
(a)    Remove the 14 bolts and 2 nuts.
(b)    Insert the blade of SST between the No.1 and No.2 oil
       pan, break the seal of the applied sealer and remove the
       No.2 oil pan.
       SST    09032-00100
NOTICE:
•    Be careful not to damage the No.2 oil pan contact sur-
     face of the No.1 oil pan.
•    Be careful not to damage the oil pan flange.

P11907

12.    REMOVE OIL STRAINER
Remove the bolt, 2 nuts, oil strainer and gasket.

P11906

13.    REMOVE OIL PAN BAFFLE PLATE
Remove the 5 bolts, 2 nuts and baffle plate.

2JZ-GTE

P19576

14.    2JZ-GTE:
       REMOVE TURBO OIL OUTLET PIPE
(a)    Disconnect the 2 turbo oil outlet hoses.
(b)    Remove the 2 nuts, oil outlet pipe and gasket.

1997 SUPRA  (RM502U)
